title: STILL PRESENT (r1): W3 stale-bounce gate is format-broken — a SAME-DAY redelivered pre-correction bounce still exhausts the corrected row and fabricates referee_contact_invalid
detail: at is RFC3339 ('T' sep, sweep now_iso) while corrected_at::text is Postgres space-separated ('2026-08-12 09:00:00+00'). Same date: 'T'(0x54)>' '(0x20) so at>corrected always -> stale same-day bounce exhausts + stamps fraud signal. Tests are date-separated, so green.
recommended_fix: Compare normalized timestamps: extract epoch or compare timestamptz in SQL (e.g. (e->>'at')::timestamptz vs corrected_at), and add a same-day stale-redelivery fixture.

title: Per-slot ?slot= start re-arms ALL queued rows of the application, not just the requested slot — behaviour unpinned by any test
detail: run_start_action re-arms after every Ok including the per-slot path; rearm SQL WHERE application_id = $1 only, so starting one row pulls every queued row's invite forward (early sends). Only the slotless path is pinned (start_reams_existing_queued_rows_test).
recommended_fix: Scope the re-arm to the requested slot (pass slot into rearm SQL) or pin the per-slot re-arm behaviour with a test asserting other rows' clocks are untouched.

title: STILL PRESENT (r1): N13 client ?slot= wire format still untested
detail: The 400 branch is now pinned server-side, but the client's URL construction (the ?slot= suffix the whole per-row start relies on) has zero coverage — Lustre effects are opaque in this suite, so a dropped or mistyped wire param would ship silently.
recommended_fix: Extract the URL builder into a pure testable function and unit-test it (Some/None slot), or use a request-capturing harness for start_check.

title: Substitute-path creation-fraud stamp (r1 N1 fold) has no test — the successor row's fraud_signals are never asserted
detail: The stamp is best-effort and log-only on failure; substitute integration tests assert row counts/audit/trio but never fraud_signals on the new row, so a dropped or failed stamp would pass CI silently.
recommended_fix: Extend substitute_creates_new_row_and_audits_old_and_new_ids_test to assert the successor row's fraud_signals carry the creation-time keys (contact reuse / line_type / form_session:null).

title: No negative test: a non-owning landlord gets 404 on the new action endpoints (verify_application_in_vacancy landlord leg untested)
evidence:
SELECT count(*)::int AS match_count
FROM application a
WHERE a.id = $1
  AND a.vacancy_id = $2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM vacancy v
    WHERE v.id = a.vacancy_id AND v.user_id = $3
detail: Every action HTTP test uses the seeded owning landlord; the new precheck's v.user_id = $3 leg has no negative case. A cross-tenant call id leaking past the precheck (404 vs 409 semantics) would pass CI.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test hitting take-over/correct/substitute with a second landlord's session and asserting 404 + no mutation/audit.

title: Wrong-person exhaustion route: the in-app notification is unasserted (webhook route is pinned, wrong-person route is not)
evidence:
let response = router.handle_request(test_router_context(db), req)
  response.status |> should.equal(200)
  row_field(db, call_id, "status") |> should.equal(Some("unreachable"))
  count_audit(db, "reference_call_correction_exhausted") |> should.equal(1)
detail: exhaust_wrong_person calls notify_reference_correction_exhausted, but the wrong-person test asserts only status + audit; a dropped notify call would pass CI (genuine_post_correction_failure_exhausts_test does pin it for the webhook path).
recommended_fix: Assert notification_count/notification_bodies in wrong_person_route_exhausts_corrected_row_test (mirroring the webhook exhaustion test).

title: W4 effective-contact rule (cleared channel stays absent after correction) has no sweep-level test
detail: The corrected-replaces-snapshot branch (AD-7 never-re-contact) is unpinned: no sweep test seeds correction_cycles>=1 with one corrected channel cleared and asserts the sweep does not fall back to the failed snapshot address.
recommended_fix: Sweep integration test: corrected row with corrected_email NULL + snapshot email present; assert the T0 invite targets only the remaining corrected channel (or none).

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: 521 integration / 544 client / 110 shared / 1477 server unit claimed green at 0fdbf93; actions suite = 22 integration tests covering take-over guards, B1 double-pin incl. negative control, substitute idempotence, both exhaustion routes, W10 404, W6 re-arm.
detail: P0 100% (take-over, one-cycle, substitute idempotence, exhaustion routes, expand-only migration all pinned). P1 ~85-89%: W3 same-day stale-bounce blind spot is the load-bearing gap; wrong-person notification, cross-landlord negative, N1 stamp, N13 client wire, W4 rule unpinned. Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Fix the genuine_failure timestamp comparison + add a same-day stale fixture; add the four missing pins (wrong-person notify, non-owning landlord 404, substitute fraud stamp, W4 cleared-channel sweep test).
